purpose: Everything the ops-timing-panel harness needs to time this lane"s DeepONet arms in ONE allocation beside the NM-ROM, POD and the full-order solver — the only construction from which a speed number for these checkpoints is admissible. This lane makes no speed claim.

families_py.why: the panel"s lib/families.py is no-second"s and has no `deeponet` entry; this file is that file plus DeepONet2d, and the U-Net and Transolver classes are untouched
families_py.check: python check_inherited.py in this lane lists exactly which files differ from no-second

model_py.why: one smoke_bounded branch; make_model dispatch is unchanged

requires.unpack: the checkpoint paths below live in a .gitignored extracted tree; if it is gone, rebuild it by concatenating runs/don01/archive-parts/part-* (manifest.json has each part"s SHA256) and untarring, then re-verify every best.pt against the sha256 recorded here

caveat: These arms are far less accurate than the FNO/U-Net/Transolver arms measured on the same data, split and metric, and all four early-stopped; a speed row for them must carry that error beside it, and the panel's own note that every operator arm already sits above the 256^2 discretisation error applies a fortiori.

accuracy_ratios_selected_arm_vs_selected.definition: this lane's validation-selected arm divided by each other family's validation-selected arm, on the 32 validation cases, fixed-initial relative error; generated, not typed
